public_body: Somerset Board Of Water And Sewer Commissioners
overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by not approving its May 8 minutes within three meetings or 30 days; a joint meeting did not supply good cause. The minutes were already approved, so no further remedy was ordered beyond future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve the minutes of its May 8 meeting; the Board approved them only at its July 24 meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate).
remedy_passage: We order the Board’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of an intent to violate the Law.
